subject: Television & Streaming
title: Black Mirror: Fiction as Warning
description: Learn Black Mirror: Fiction as Warning in one minute.

hook.text: Black Mirror imagines futures where technology fails us: social credit scores, memory implants, and AI copies of the dead.

buildup.text: Each episode presents a plausible dystopia. The technology is always just a few steps ahead of what already exists.

discovery.text: China's actual social credit system eerily resembled a Black Mirror episode. Fiction was becoming documentary.

twist.text: The show's creator, Charlie Brooker, said he worries that his warnings are being used as instruction manuals instead.

climax.text: Black Mirror proved that science fiction on television can serve as society's early warning system for technological.

punchline.text: The scariest science fiction is the kind that comes true.

quiz.question: What makes Black Mirror effective as social commentary?
options: Its scenarios are plausible extensions of existing technology trends
